item.title: Building an Automated, Serverless MLBB Meta Hub on GitHub Pages
item.description:
Gaming wikis are notoriously frustrating to use. Between intrusive banner ads, bloated tracking scripts, and outdated community builds that haven’t been touched in three patches, finding exact item-by-item interaction logic is a chore.

I set out to build an alternative: a clean, deterministic, zero-bloat game database for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) running on Original Server Patch 2.1.95a. The entire system is open-source, version-controlled, and hosted for free on GitHub Pages without maintaining an expensive backend database.

item.title: Building OCR2MD: From a Simple OCR Script to a Production-Ready OCR-to-Markdown Platform
item.description:
Building OCR2MD: A Complete OCR-to-Markdown Platform

Modern organizations deal with thousands of scanned documents every year. Reports, invoices, audit records, government files, historical archives, handwritten forms, meeting notes, and books often exist only as scanned PDFs or images.

Extracting this information into a structured format is surprisingly difficult.

Most OCR tools only recover plain text. Tables lose their structure, headings become paragraphs, images disappear, and manually cleaning the results consumes far more time than the OCR itself.

item.title: Mastering Folder Synchronization in Linux Mint: A Complete Guide to rsync, Automation, and Two-Way Backups
item.description:
Mastering Folder Synchronization in Linux Mint: A Complete Guide to rsync, Automation, and Two-Way Backups

Whether you are performing routine maintenance, preparing a secondary backup, or transferring personal settings across installations, keeping your user profile data in sync is a fundamental Linux administration skill. In Linux Mint, user settings (like .icons and .themes) and standard data directories (Downloads, Documents, Desktop, Pictures, Music, Videos) store the core of your desktop experience and digital life.

item.title: Mastering Google Docs Spacing: How to Remove Extra Spaces, Blank Lines, Phantom Pages, and Automate Workflow with Apps Script
item.description:
Mastering Google Docs Spacing: How to Remove Extra Spaces, Blank Lines, Phantom Pages, and Automate Workflow with Apps Script

When working on professional reports, administrative documents, or collaborative projects in Google Docs, clean formatting is essential. However, copying content from external sources—such as PDFs, web pages, plain text files, or email threads—frequently introduces unwanted layout artifacts. These include runaway double spaces, endless strings of blank lines, erratic paragraph padding, and stubborn blank pages that refuse to delete.

item.title: The Ultimate Daily Tech Coach: Mastering Linux, Python, AI, and Pentesting from Day One
item.description:
Building a consistent routine to learn complex technical skills can feel like a daunting task. Between sorting through endless documentation, figuring out what tools to use, and finding practical hands-on exercises, it is easy to get stuck in tutorial hell.

To solve this, we can turn an LLM into an automated, highly disciplined daily instructor. By combining Linux terminal fundamentals, Python scripting, legal penetration testing, and modern 2026 AI workflows, you can create a self-sustaining curriculum that levels up your skills every single day.
